lotes: flat barbell bench press: lying on a flat bench, feet on the floor, gripping a loaded barbell slightly wider than shoulders, bar lowered to the mid-chest (nipple line), elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
incline barbell bench press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, bar lowered to the upper chest
decline barbell bench press: lying on a decline bench with legs hooked under the pads, bar lowered to the lower chest
flat dumbbell bench press: lying on a flat bench, one dumbbell in each hand pressed up above the chest, arms almost straight
incline dumbbell press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, dumbbells at upper-chest level with elbows bent
flat dumbbell fly: lying on a flat bench, arms opened wide to the sides with a slight elbow bend, dumbbells at chest height
dumbbell pullover: lying on a flat bench, holding one dumbbell with both hands behind the head, arms extended overhead
cable crossover: standing between the two high pulleys of a cable crossover machine, slight forward lean, pulling both handles down and together in front of the hips
pec deck machine fly: seated upright in a pec deck machine, bringing the two padded arms together in front of the chest
seated chest press machine: seated with back on the pad, pushing the handles forward at chest height
push-up: body in a straight plank on hands and toes, chest lowered close to the floor, hands slightly wider than shoulders
chest dip on parallel bars: supporting the body on two parallel bars, torso leaning forward, elbows bent to 90 degrees, legs bent behind
Smith machine bench press: lying on a flat bench inside a Smith machine (barbell fixed on vertical rails), bar lowered to the mid-chest
resistance band chest press: standing, a resistance band anchored behind at chest height, pressing both band handles straight forward
pull-up: hanging from an overhead bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulders, pulled up with the chin above the bar, rear three-quarter view
assisted pull-up machine: kneeling on the padded counterweight platform of an assisted pull-up machine, pulling up with an overhand grip
lat pulldown: seated at a cable pulldown machine, thighs under the pads, pulling a wide bar down to the upper chest, rear three-quarter view
close neutral-grip lat pulldown: seated at a cable pulldown machine, pulling a V-handle (palms facing each other) down to the upper chest, rear three-quarter view
bent-over barbell row: hinged at the hips with the torso at about 45 degrees, knees slightly bent, back flat, pulling the barbell to the lower ribs
one-arm dumbbell row: one knee and one hand resting on a flat bench, back flat, the other arm pulling a dumbbell up to the hip
seated cable row: seated on a low cable row bench, feet on the foot platform, torso upright, pulling a V-handle to the abdomen
seated row machine: seated with the chest against the pad, pulling both handles back, elbows close to the body
chest-supported dumbbell row: lying face down on an incline bench, a dumbbell in each hand pulled up beside the ribs
T-bar row: standing over a barbell anchored at one end (landmine), hinged at the hips, pulling a V-handle under the bar up to the chest
standing straight-arm cable pulldown: facing a high pulley, slight hip hinge, arms almost straight pushing a straight bar down to the thighs
TRX inverted row: holding TRX suspension straps, body leaning back in a straight line with heels on the floor, chest pulled up to the hands
inverted row: lying under a barbell set in a rack at waist height, body straight, heels on the floor, chest pulled up to the bar
resistance band seated row: seated on the floor with legs straight, a resistance band looped around the feet, rowing the handles to the waist
back extension: hips on the pad of a 45-degree hyperextension bench, ankles locked, torso raised up in line with the legs
dumbbell shrug: standing, a dumbbell in each hand with arms straight at the sides, shoulders shrugged up toward the ears
standing barbell overhead press: standing upright, barbell pressed from the shoulders to overhead with arms almost locked
seated dumbbell shoulder press: seated on an upright bench, dumbbells pressed overhead from shoulder height
Arnold press: seated on an upright bench, dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing the body, rotating the palms forward while pressing up
seated shoulder press machine: seated with the back on the pad, pressing the handles overhead
dumbbell lateral raise: standing, raising a dumbbell in each hand out to the sides up to shoulder height, slight elbow bend
cable lateral raise: standing side-on to a low cable pulley, raising a single handle across the body and out to the side up to shoulder height with the far arm
dumbbell front raise: standing, raising dumbbells straight in front of the body up to shoulder height
bent-over dumbbell reverse fly: torso hinged forward almost parallel to the floor, raising the dumbbells out to the sides
reverse pec deck: seated facing the chest pad of a pec deck machine, pulling the handles backward and apart with straight arms
cable face pull: standing facing a high cable pulley with a rope attachment, pulling the rope toward the face with elbows high and wide
landmine press: standing, one end of a barbell anchored in a floor landmine, pressing the other end up and forward with one hand
band pull-apart: standing, arms straight in front at shoulder height, pulling a resistance band apart out to the sides
standing barbell curl: standing, underhand grip, elbows fixed at the sides, curling the barbell up halfway
standing dumbbell curl: standing, palms facing up, curling the dumbbells up with elbows at the sides
hammer curl: standing, neutral grip with palms facing each other, curling the dumbbells up
incline dumbbell curl: seated leaning back on a bench inclined about 45 degrees, arms hanging behind the torso, curling the dumbbells
barbell preacher curl: seated at a preacher bench, upper arms resting on the angled pad, curling a straight barbell up
standing cable curl: facing a low cable pulley, curling a straight bar up with elbows at the sides
concentration curl: seated on a flat bench, elbow braced against the inner thigh, curling a single dumbbell
biceps curl machine: seated with the upper arms on the machine pad, curling the handles up
rope triceps pushdown: standing facing a high cable pulley, elbows tucked at the sides, pushing a rope down to the thighs and spreading its ends
straight-bar triceps pushdown: standing facing a high cable pulley, elbows tucked at the sides, pushing a short straight bar down to the thighs
seated overhead dumbbell triceps extension: seated upright, one dumbbell held with both hands behind the head, elbows pointing up, extending the arms overhead
overhead cable triceps extension: standing facing away from a cable pulley, rope held behind the head, elbows pointing forward, extending the arms overhead
lying barbell triceps extension (skull crusher): lying on a flat bench, upper arms vertical, barbell lowered toward the forehead by bending the elbows
close-grip bench press: lying on a flat bench, hands shoulder-width apart, elbows tucked, barbell lowered to the lower chest
dumbbell triceps kickback: bent over with one hand and knee on a bench, upper arm parallel to the floor, forearm extended straight back
triceps dip on parallel bars: supporting the body on two parallel bars, torso upright, elbows pointing back and bent to 90 degrees
seated wrist curl: seated, forearms resting on the thighs with palms facing up, curling the dumbbells up with the wrists only
seated wrist extension: seated, forearms resting on the thighs with palms facing down, lifting the dumbbells with the wrists only
reverse barbell curl: standing, overhand grip (palms down), curling the barbell up with elbows at the sides
dead hang: hanging from an overhead pull-up bar, arms straight, feet off the floor, body relaxed
plate pinch hold: standing upright, in each hand two smooth weight plates pinched together between fingers and thumb, arms straight at the sides
barbell back squat: barbell resting across the upper back behind the neck, standing freely with no bench or box, at the bottom of the squat with thighs parallel to the floor, chest up
barbell front squat: barbell resting on the front of the shoulders with elbows high, standing freely, deep squat with torso upright
goblet squat: holding one kettlebell at the chest with both hands, deep squat with torso upright
45-degree leg press: seated reclined in a leg press machine, feet on the platform, knees bent near 90 degrees
hack squat machine: back against the angled padded sled, shoulders under the pads, squatting down with thighs near parallel
Smith machine squat: standing inside a Smith machine, bar on the upper back, squatting with thighs parallel to the floor
leg extension machine: seated, ankles behind the lower pad, extending the knees to lift the legs forward
dumbbell lunge: dumbbells hanging at the sides, long forward step, front thigh parallel to the floor, back knee close to the floor
Bulgarian split squat: rear foot resting on a bench behind, dumbbells at the sides, front leg bent with thigh parallel to the floor
dumbbell step-up: stepping up onto a box with one foot, dumbbells hanging at the sides
bodyweight squat: no equipment, arms extended forward for balance, thighs parallel to the floor
TRX squat: holding the TRX suspension strap handles in front with arms extended, sitting back into a deep squat
barbell Romanian deadlift: hips pushed back, knees slightly bent, back flat, barbell lowered to mid-shin close to the legs
dumbbell Romanian deadlift: hips pushed back, knees slightly bent, back flat, a dumbbell in each hand lowered to mid-shin in front of the legs
lying leg curl machine: lying face down on the machine, curling the ankle pad toward the glutes
seated leg curl machine: seated with the thigh pad locked, pushing the lower pad down and back under the seat
Nordic hamstring curl: kneeling on a pad with the ankles held down, body straight from knees to head, slowly leaning forward
barbell good morning: barbell on the upper back, knees slightly bent, hinging forward at the hips until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat
single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift: balancing on one leg, the other leg extended straight back, torso tilted forward, dumbbell in the opposite hand
TRX hamstring curl: lying on the back with the heels in TRX foot cradles, hips lifted, curling the heels toward the glutes
barbell hip thrust: upper back resting on a bench, padded barbell across the hips, hips driven up to full extension, knees at 90 degrees
hip thrust machine: upper back on the machine pad, padded belt over the hips, hips driven up to full extension
glute bridge: lying on the back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat, hips lifted up
cable glute kickback: standing facing a low cable pulley with an ankle strap, kicking one straight leg back
seated hip abduction machine: seated, pushing the knees outward against the side pads
banded hip abduction: seated on the floor leaning back on the hands, a mini resistance band around the thighs above the knees, pushing the knees apart
cable pull-through: facing away from a low cable pulley, rope held between the legs, hinging forward then driving the hips forward to stand
dumbbell reverse lunge: dumbbells at the sides, stepping one leg back, front thigh parallel to the floor
standing calf raise machine: shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the block, rising up on the toes
seated calf raise machine: seated, knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the block, rising up on the toes
calf press on a 45-degree leg press: seated reclined, legs straight, balls of the feet on the bottom edge of the platform, pushing with the ankles
single-leg calf raise: standing on one foot on the edge of a step, one hand on a wall for balance, rising up on the toes
Smith machine calf raise: standing inside a Smith machine, bar on the upper back, balls of the feet on a raised block, rising up on the toes
forearm plank: on the forearms and toes, body in a straight line from head to heels, side view
side plank: supported on one forearm and the side of one foot, hips lifted, body in a straight line
floor crunch: lying on the back, knees bent, feet flat, hands beside the head, curling the shoulders off the floor
kneeling cable crunch: kneeling facing a high cable pulley, rope held beside the head, curling the torso down toward the knees
hanging leg raise: hanging from a pull-up bar, raising straight legs up to horizontal
dead bug: lying on the back, one arm extended overhead and the opposite leg extended straight, the other arm and leg pointing up with knee bent at 90 degrees
bird dog: on hands and knees, extending one arm straight forward and the opposite leg straight back, back flat
Pallof press: standing side-on to a cable pulley set at chest height, pressing the handle straight out in front of the chest with both hands, resisting rotation
ab wheel rollout: kneeling, both hands on an ab wheel rolled far forward, body stretched long and straight
cable woodchop: standing side-on to a high cable pulley, rotating the torso and pulling the handle diagonally down across the body with both hands
reverse crunch: lying on the back, knees bent, lifting the hips off the floor and curling the knees toward the chest
TRX knee tuck: in a push-up plank with both feet in the TRX foot cradles, pulling the knees in toward the chest
conventional barbell deadlift: feet hip-width, hands just outside the knees, back flat, bar lifted from the floor to knee height
sumo deadlift: very wide stance with toes pointed out, hands gripping the bar inside the knees, torso upright, lifting the bar from the floor
two-hand kettlebell swing: hips fully extended, standing tall, arms straight holding the kettlebell at chest height
dumbbell thruster: rising from a squat while pressing the dumbbells from the shoulders to overhead
burpee: shown in the plank phase, hands on the floor and chest lowered close to the floor, legs straight behind, ready to jump up
farmer's walk: walking upright mid-stride, holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides
barbell power clean, catch position: barbell racked on the front of the shoulders, elbows high and forward, in a quarter squat
kettlebell Turkish get-up, bridge phase: supported on one straight arm and both feet, hips lifted high, the other arm pointing straight up holding a kettlebell overhead
